## ✏️ Region Editing — Full Control After Generation

The numbered bounding boxes define where each subject or element
sits in your composition. Each box maps to a text description
that Ideogram uses for prompt adherence.

**What you can do:**
- **Move / resize** any bbox to reframe subjects or background zones
- **Edit region text** to refine exactly what appears in that area
- **Add or delete regions** for more or less compositional control
- **Switch TYPE** between `obj` (object/subject) and `text` (rendered
  text inside the image) per region

This is where Ideogram 4's legendary prompt adherence comes from —
the more precise your regions and descriptions, the more accurately
the model places elements exactly where you want them.

## 🔄 Swap the Vision Model Anytime

The model field accepts any HuggingFace repo ID of a vision-capable LLM.
The node will auto-download it on first use — no manual setup required.

**Recommended models:**
- `huihui-ai/Huihui-gemma-4-E4B-it-abliterated` ← default, balanced
- `huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-abliterated` — clean outputs, fast

⚠️ Must be a **vision model** (accepts image input).
Text-only LLMs will not work for image-to-prompt mode.

4-bit quantization is available via the checkbox to reduce VRAM usage.
Recommended if you are on 8–12GB VRAM cards.

## ⚠️ Local Model Quality — Important Caveat

Local models (4B / 8B) will generate valid prompts, but the
quality, coherence, and scene-building depth will be noticeably
weaker compared to frontier models like **Gemini 3.5 Flash** or higher parameter model like Gemma4:31B.

Small local models tend to make plenty of mistakes.

**If you want the best prompt quality**, use the Gemini engine
with Gemini 3.5 Flash — it understands compositional intent
far better and produces prompts that fully leverage Ideogram 4's
prompt adherence capabilities.

**However**, if you insist on running locally, go for the
largest model your VRAM can handle. A 12B+ vision model
will get you meaningfully closer to frontier-level output
quality than a 4B or 8B model — the gap narrows significantly
as model size increases.

Local is great for privacy and cost — just set your expectations
accordingly, and always remember you can edit the output before
hitting Generate.

# 🧠 Ideogram 4 Autoprompter — How It Works

This node supercharges your Ideogram 4 prompting by auto-generating
a structured, region-aware JSON prompt from a simple idea or image.

**Two ways to run it:**
- **Text only** → Type a brief concept or instruction (e.g. "asian girl, doll like face")
  and the AI expands it into a full scene with regions, style, and lighting.
- **Image + Text** → Upload a reference image and the node captions it,
  then builds a prompt that matches and enhances what it sees.

**Engine options:**
- **Local** → Uses a local HuggingFace vision model (auto-downloaded on
  first run). Free, private, no API key needed.
- **Gemini** → Uses Google's Gemini API for higher quality outputs.
  Get a free key at aistudio.google.com — Gemini 3.5 Flash recommended.

 # **After generation, nothing is locked.**
## You can freely edit the bounding boxes, region descriptions, style tags, lighting, and colors before hitting Generate. The AI gives you a strong starting point — you stay in control of the final result.
